about: The property rules' research cases, each an edit of an object a file MATLAB R2027a, R2023b or R2024b saved (or one merged from the R2023b templates, or a CoderInfo in either layout), its right-hand side as MATLAB saved it: the verdict and the triple ops of the rules' reference implementation, which the research live gates verified against MATLAB. A case is [name, set, original, edits [[object path, property, value]], ops]; one with no ops is refused. A value is the miMATRIX element of `v`, base64. Ops are set:<object>:<saved name>:<encoding and value, a double by its bits> or remove:<object>:<saved name>, sorted.
